newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle prices not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle prices not established - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow and prices on slaughter steers and heifers were not established, USDA said. Buyer interest very light, some off the market. Seller interest continues light.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1350 lbs 72.00. Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales.

Dressed Basis Delivered. (paid on hot carcass weights) Steers and heifers not established, but a lower undertone noted. Dressed Basis Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 113.00-113.50. ( weighted average 113.13 ) Dressed Basis Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 113.00.
Wk To Date- 3,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 12,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 87,200
